remarks:
This recreational property with building site consists of 13.22 acres and is located in South Dayton NY, Chautauqua County.

The land is mostly level and offers a beautiful mix of open shrub land in the front with mature hardwoods towards the back creating an ideal setting for recreation, hunting, or a future homesite. With scenic countryside views and a peaceful rural atmosphere, this property is a great location to build a home, cabin, or weekend getaway.

Excellent hunting opportunities abound with strong whitetail deer and turkey sign throughout the property. Nearby crop fields to the south provide an additional food source for wildlife making this an outstanding area for hunters and outdoor enthusiasts.

The property features approximately 282 feet of road frontage with electric available at the road offering easy access and convenience for future development. Whether you are looking for recreational land, a private retreat, or a place to enjoy the outdoors, this property offers exceptional potential in a desirable area. All oil, gas, mineral, and timber rights convey.  Additional acreage available upon request.

Conveniently located approximately 12 minutes to Forestville, 20 minutes to Gowanda, 25 minutes to Dunkirk, 40 minutes to Springville, 50 minutes to Buffalo, and 1 hour 10 minutes to Erie.
